Notes to Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and six months period ended September 30, 2026
1. The Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of Amagi Media Labs Limited (formerly Amagi Media Labs Private Limited) (the "Holding Company") together with its subsidiaries and controlled trust (collectively "the Group") have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standards as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, as amended, read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015, as amended and other accounting principles generally accepted in India and in terms of Regulation 33 of the Securities Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015 ('SEBI LODR'), as amended ("Listing Regulations").

These Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee at its meeting held on November 4, 2026 and approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 5, 2026. These Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results have been subjected to limited review by the statutory auditors of the Holding Company.
2. The unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 have been compiled by the management and approved by the Board of Directors of the Holding Company, which have not been subjected to audit or limited review by the statutory auditors.
3. During the year ended March 31, 2026, the Holding Company completed its Initial Public Offering (IPO) of 49,546,221 equity shares of nominal value of Rs. 5 each at an issue price of Rs. 361 per share (including securities premium of Rs. 356 per share). The issue comprised of a fresh issue of 22,603,878 equity shares aggregating to Rs. 8,160.00 million and an offer for sale of 26,942,343 equity shares by selling shareholders aggregating to Rs. 9,726.19 million. The Holding Company's equity shares were listed on BSE Limited (BSE) and National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) on January 21, 2026.
4. During the year ended March 31, 2026, the Holding Company, pursuant to a circular resolution dated July 15, 2025, converted 3,804 Series D1 Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares of nominal value Rs. 100 each into Equity Shares of nominal value Rs. 5 each, in the conversion ratio of 1:72, in accordance with the terms of issue. Further, on November 21, 2025 the Board of Directors of the Holding Company approved conversion of 12,430,901 (all outstanding) Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares into 159,300,958 Equity Shares of the Holding Company. The equity shares so issued rank pari passu with the existing equity shares of the Holding Company.
5. During the quarter and six months period ended September 30, 2026, the Holding Company has allotted 3,814,258 equity shares having nominal value of Rs. 5 each upon exercise of vested options under the Amagi Employee Stock Option Plan 2025.
6. Argoid Analytics Private Limited, a subsidiary, was under voluntary liquidation since November 17, 2025. Pursuant to an order of the National Company Law Tribunal, Bengaluru Bench, dated July 31, 2026, the subsidiary was dissolved, and the dissolution was taken on record by the Registrar of Companies on August 31, 2026.
7. The Holding Company has significant unabsorbed depreciation and carried forward losses and has also incurred tax losses for the year ended March 31, 2026. Considering uncertainty that sufficient taxable profits will be available with the Holding Company in the foreseeable future against which such deferred tax assets can be realised, no deferred tax assets have been recognised by the Holding Company in its consolidated financial results as at and for the period ended September 30, 2026, in accordance with Ind AS 12.

8. On October 22, 2026, the Holding Company’s management was notified of a cyber extortion threat relating to one of its edge transmission sites. The Holding Company notified CERT-In, made a disclosure to the stock exchanges under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. Based on its preliminary assessment, management does not expect the incident to have a material financial impact on the Group.

9. The Group is engaged in the business of providing media technologies and related services which represents single reportable segment as per Ind AS 108, and hence no separate disclosures are required for segments.
